For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:
https://images.redhat.com/
mitigations: To mitigate this issue, users should avoid processing untrusted or suspicious ELF files with the `readelf` utility. No specific configuration or operational control is available to prevent this vulnerability without affecting the intended functionality of `readelf`.
